data.name: /bin/sh -c "python3 -c \"import sqlite3; con = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db'); con.executemany('INSERT INTO products (id, name, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', [(1, 'Widget', 10), (2, 'Gadget', 5), (3, 'Gizmo', 0)]); con.commit(); con.close()\" && python3 -c \"import sqlite3; con = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db'); print('count:', con.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products').fetchone()[0]); print(*con.execute('SELECT id, name, quantity FROM products ORDER BY id').fetchall(), sep='\\n'); con.close()\""
